2 Regional by direct extension only

  o Anterior eyelid lamella  o Caruncle  o Eyelid margin (lower and/or upper)  o Lacrimal punctum and canaliculi (lower and/or upper)  o Plica  o Posterior eyelid lamella

- Adjacent paranasal sinuses
- Bone, bone of orbit
- Orbit, NOS
- Orbital soft tissues WITHOUT bone invasion
